Notice Of Motion For Default Prove-Up Against Defendant Automotive Innovations, Inc.
Off Calendar May-17-2016 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Joseph M. Quinn, Clerk: A. Mok, CSR: Mitch Lyon, CSR#6840

Christopher F. Tuttle, Esq., appearing for Plaintiff, RUSSELL BRIMER,
No appearance by defaulted defendant AUTOMOTIVE INNOVATIONS, INC.,
Default of Defendant has been duly entered.

After Evidence and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff and against Defaulted Defendant as follows:

Automotive Innovations, Inc. is permanently enjoined from offering any vinyl/PVC seat covers containing Di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) in California without providing clear and reasonable warnings regarding the risks of birth defects or other reproductive harm caused by DEHP exposures as required by Health and Safety Code section 25249.7(b). This includes but is not limited to the following products:
Saddleman Seat cover, Part # 19452-14, UPC #0 42374 66132 6.

Damages: $2500.00 in statutory penalties pursuant to Health and Safety Code section 25249.7(b)
Pre-Judgment Interest: $0
Attorney's Fees and Costs: $30,221.86
Total Judgment in the amount of $32,721.86

Judgment signed in open court.
